31792-IXA.s: The bill amends the 2008 budget statement of the National Debt (IXA) to reflect the second supplementary budget (linked to the autumn budget memorandum), adjusting expenditure and revenue estimates in thousands of euros. It sets the amendment's entry into force from 1 December 2008 with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
31792-IXA.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by the large increase in the state's financing needs following government crisis measures, but it does not justify any delegation or new powers.
q: Due to the various measures the Dutch State has taken in response to the credit crisis, the Treasury's financing requirement has risen sharply.
Door de diverse maatregelen die de Nederlandse Staat naar aanleiding van de kredietcrisis heeft genomen, is de financieringsbehoefte van het Rijk fors gestegen.

32360-XII.s: This bill amends the 2009 budget statutes (departmental and cost-center budget statements) of the Ministry of Transport and Water Management, adjusting appropriations and realisations in euros; it contains only technical, bookkeeping and audit-driven changes. It enters into force the day after publication and applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
32360-XII.j: The explanatory memorandum says only technical implementation, bookkeeping and control-finding changes are included, so no new powers are justified.
q: This bill contains only technical implementation changes, bookkeeping changes, or changes arising from audit findings.
In dit wetsvoorstel zijn alleen technische uitvoeringsmutaties, mutaties van boekhoudkundige aard of mutaties voortvloeiend uit controlebevindingen opgenomen.

32395-IXA.s: This bill amends the 2010 budget statement for Nationale Schuld (national debt) by adjusting expenditure and receipts for financing the state debt and cash management, in thousands of euros. It sets the effective date as 1 June 2010, with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.
q: Article 1: The budget statement of National Debt (IXA) for 2010 is amended as shown in the statement attached to this act.
Artikel 1 De begrotingsstaat van Nationale Schuld (IXA) voor het jaar 2010 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

32500-XV.s: This bill fixes the 2011 departmental expenditure budget of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (SZW) and the budgets of its baten-lastendiensten (Agentschap SZW and Inspectie Werk en Inkomen). It sets amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect on 1 January 2011.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) attached to this law for the year 2011 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (XV) voor het jaar 2011 wordt vastgesteld.

32565-IXB.s: This bill amends the 2010 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) to reflect the Najaarsnota adjustments, setting figures in thousands of euros and taking effect from 1 December 2010. The accompanying explanatory memorandum records revised expenditure and revenue estimates for the tax, financial markets and asset management policy articles.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) for the year 2010 is amended as shown in the statement annexed to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IXB) voor het jaar 2010 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

33280-VII.s: The bill amends the 2012 departmental budget statements of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (budget chapter VII) and the statements for its business-operations services, shifting amounts in thousands of euros across articles. The explanatory memorandum explains that incidental room is created for governance programme activities such as training for island governors in Caribbean Netherlands, preparation of Interbestuurlijk Toezicht implementation and the European Citizens' Initiative certification procedure.
33280-VII.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by the need to finance ministerial commitments on governance, the WIN settlement timing and compensation to another ministry, not by any new executive power.
q: To be able to finance a number of commitments by the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations in the area of governance, room is incidentally freed up within the GBA budget financing.

Om een aantal toezeggingen van de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties op het gebied van bestuur te kunnen financieren, wordt binnen de budgetfinanciering GBA incidenteel ruimte vrijgemaakt.

33400-XV.s: This bill sets the 2013 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment and the 2013 budget of its baten-lastendiensten (Agentschap SZW and Inspectie Werk en Inkomen) in thousands of euros, effective 1 January 2013. The explanatory memorandum describes spending and policy changes across labour, benefits, childcare, pensions and child allowances, with no delegation of rule-making powers to the executive.
q: Article 1 The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) for the year 2013 attached to this act is established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (XV) voor het jaar 2013 wordt vastgesteld.

33640-VII.s: This bill amends the 2013 budget statements (begrotingsstaten) of the Ministry of Interior and Kingdom Relations, the Ministry of Housing and Central Government Affairs, and the associated agencies, adjusting appropriations in thousands of euros. It sets the entry-into-force date as 1 June 2013 with retroactive effect provisions if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has emerged for an amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Interior and Kingdom Relations
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat

34000-VIII.s: The bill sets the 2015 budget for the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and its agencies (DUO and Nationaal Archief), fixing spending and receipts in thousands of euros for the policy articles and operating costs. The accompanying explanatory memorandum lists policy goals, budget flows and subsidy and grant schemes, with no delegation of rule-making power evident in the excerpt.
q: The budget statement belonging to this law for the year 2015 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2015 wordt vastgesteld.

34210-XV.s: The bill amends the 2015 budget statutes of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment and of its agency, following the spring budget memorandum, by adjusting appropriations and receipts in thousands of euros. It sets the entry-into-force date as 1 June 2015 with retroactive effect where publication falls later.
q: We Willem-Alexander ... have resolved and decided ... The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) for the year 2015 is amended.
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (XV) voor het jaar 2015 wordt gewijzigd.

34300-XV.s: This bill sets the 2016 departmental expenditure and revenue budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (SZW) and the budget of its Agentschap SZW, in thousands of euros, and takes effect from 1 January 2016. The explanatory memorandum extract covers budget policy, social security schemes and oversight matters but the bill itself contains no delegation of rule-making power.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) for the year 2016, annexed to this law, is hereby adopted.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (XV) voor het jaar 2016 wordt vastgesteld.

34475-IX.s: The bill formally amends the 2015 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt budget statement (IXA) through a supplementary budget law (slotwet). It sets the figures in thousands of euros and makes the amendments effective from the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Having considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt budget statement (IXA), both for the year 2015

Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IXB), en van de begrotingsstaat van de Nationale Schuld (IXA), beide voor het jaar 2015

35143-(R2120).s: The bill approves, under Article 91(1) of the Constitution, a 2012 Netherlands-United States agreement on the status of US personnel in the Caribbean part of the Kingdom, and a 2018 exchange of notes extending that agreement to Curaçao. It contains only the approval article and an entry-into-force clause, with no delegation or new executive powers.
q: Whereas We have considered that the Agreement between the Kingdom of the Netherlands and the United States of America concerning the status of United States personnel in the Caribbean part of the Kingdom, concluded at Washington on 19 October 2012, requires approval by the States General under Article 91(1) of the Constitution before the Kingdom can be bound.

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de op 19 oktober 2012 te Washington tot stand gekomen Overeenkomst tussen het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden en de Verenigde Staten van Amerika inzake de status van personeel van de Verenigde Staten in het Caribische deel van het Koninkrijk

parties: No questions; welcomes the status-of-forces agreement without further comment.
They have no further questions about the bill.
Zij hebben over het wetsvoorstel geen verdere vragen.
Asks why the extension comes now given US threats toward Venezuela, whether Curaçao's population supports it, and whether the US has respected the underlying agreement.
Furthermore, the D66 members wonder whether there is support among the Curaçao population for extending this agreement to Curaçao.
Verder vragen de leden van de D66-fractie zich af of er draagvlak bestaat onder de bevolking van Curaçao om deze overeenkomst naar Curaçao uit te breiden.
Worries about the timing given US aggression toward Venezuela, asks for information on US military activities and Dutch notification, and asks whether US military use of Curaçao is fully excluded.
Is it completely ruled out that the US could use Curaçao in any way for military activities, whether covert or not, aimed at Venezuela?
Is volledig uitgesloten dat de VS Curaçao op enigerlei wijze kan gebruiken voor militaire activiteiten, al dan niet heimelijk, gericht tegen Venezuela?

35200-XV.s: This bill amends the 2018 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment, adjusting appropriations and expenditures to reflect actual realisation. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and provides that the law takes effect the day after publication and applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
35200-XV.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the adjustments by explaining that planned activities on several policy lines did not proceed or were not completed on time, leading to lower spending than budgeted.
q: Most of this is related to planned activities not going ahead or not being completed on time.
Het merendeel hiervan hangt samen met het geen doorgang vinden of niet tijdig tot stand komen van een aantal voorgenomen activiteiten

35350-VII.s: This second supplementary budget bill amends the 2019 budget statements of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and its agencies, shifting appropriations and receipts across policy articles such as housing, energy transition and building quality. It sets the amended figures in thousands of euros and makes the act effective the day after publication, retroactive to 1 December 2019.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) for the year 2019 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this act.

De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (VII) voor het jaar 2019 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35975-III.s: This bill amends the 2021 budget statements (second supplementary budget) for the Ministry of General Affairs, the Cabinet of the King, and the Commission for Oversight of the Intelligence and Security Services, mainly to add funds for collective labour agreement costs. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and gives the amended statements retroactive effect from 1 December 2021.
q: From the labour-conditions budget item, the Ministry of Finance made additional funds available to the Commission for Oversight of the Intelligence and Security Services for the CAO Rijk.

Vanuit de post arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn door het Ministerie van Financiën aanvullende middelen beschikbaar gesteld aan de Commissie van Toezicht op de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten ten behoeve van de CAO Rijk.

36100-XV.s: This bill amends the 2021 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (Slotwet), setting realised expenditure and revenue against the amended budget across policy and non-policy articles. It also sets the law's entry into force the day after Staatsblad publication, applying retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) for the year 2021.
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (XV) voor het jaar 2021.

36250-VII.s: This second supplementary budget bill amends the 2022 departmental budget of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and the budgets of its executive agencies, in thousands of euros, with effect from the day after publication and retroactive to 1 December 2022. It is a purely budgetary adjustment that changes appropriation amounts for policy articles such as housing, energy transition and Groningen, and does not delegate rule-making power or alter oversight of the executive.
q: We Willem-Alexander ... have resolved and decided ... The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) for the year 2022 is amended

Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (VII) voor het jaar 2022 wordt gewijzigd

36410-XII.s: This bill sets the 2024 departmental budget statements (begrotingsstaten) for the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management and its executive agencies, fixing appropriations and receipts in thousands of euros with entry into force on 1 January of the budget year. The explanatory memorandum describes policy roles, programmes and external financial references across water, roads, aviation, maritime, environment and meteorology, without creating new delegated rule-making powers.
q: The departmental budget statement for the year 2024 that belongs to this act is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2024 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering issued no remarks on the 2024 budget bill for the Ministry of Infrastructure and Waterstaat (XII), advising it be submitted to the Tweede Kamer. No government reply on substantive points is included, only the cover note from the Minister of Finance.

36725-IX.s: This bill amends the 2025 departmental budget statements of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt (IXA) through a first supplementary budget, adjusting expenditure, revenue and commitment figures in thousands of euros with retroactive effect from 1 June 2025. The explanatory memorandum reports tax revenue changes, commitment increases and budget flexibility figures for the Ministry of Finance articles without delegating rule-making power.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IX) for the year 2025
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IX), voor het jaar 2025
